name: Bearing casing
function: Houses and supports the turbocharger shaft bearings while providing passages for lubrication and cooling.
location: Between the compressor and turbine casings
maintenance: Check bearing clearances, oil supply and drain passages, seals, temperature and signs of vibration or leakage.

name: Compressor casing
function: Collects and directs compressed intake air from the compressor wheel toward the engine charge-air system.
location: Air side of the turbocharger around the compressor wheel
maintenance: Inspect the casing and diffuser for fouling, erosion, rubbing marks, cracks and loose connections.

name: Turbocharger cover
function: Encloses and protects the turbocharger assembly while providing access for inspection and servicing.
location: Outer end of the turbocharger casing assembly
maintenance: Inspect the cover, fasteners, sealing faces and gasket for damage, looseness or leakage.

name: Air intake silencer
function: Reduces compressor intake noise and helps guide clean air into the turbocharger inlet.
maintenance: Clean the intake passages and filter elements; inspect the housing and connections for restriction or damage.

name: Turbine casing
function: Directs engine exhaust gas through the turbine wheel to drive the turbocharger shaft and compressor.
location: Exhaust-gas side of the turbocharger around the turbine wheel
maintenance: Inspect for carbon deposits, erosion, cracks, gas leakage, rubbing marks and damaged mounting connections.
